retention: Library retention on both sides: JS keeps ESM exports; Lil export class is type-only so keepers call public constructors/methods. Unused privates may DCE. CSS-only and re-export JS files are excluded. Tiny Lil rows are incomplete ports, not a different tree-shaker.

drifts.title: string +=
drifts.body: Lil documents +=. In large monaco compiles, SSA coalescing can alias this/params and break string accumulation. The port builds strings with emptyBuf() / concat2() instead of "" + +=. Numeric += in the JS host is ordinary JavaScript.

drifts.title: SSA lowering
drifts.body: Piece-tree rbDelete, nodeAt, offsets, decoration ids, and Myers diff run in js-host.ts so those paths do not depend on the broken lowering.

drifts.title: view / GPU
drifts.body: Lil viewport + textarea + minimap canvas. Not monaco editor/browser/view.js, view-zones, or GPU rendering.

drifts.title: contrib menus
drifts.body: Context menus and several contrib commands still differ. Types describe the ported surface, not the full official monaco.d.ts.

drifts.title: editor CSS
drifts.body: The old 2KB sheet was a stub. monaco.css is official editor.main.css plus the generated vs/vs-dark/hc --vscode-* theme sheet monaco injects at runtime, plus extras for the Lil paint-path token classes. Fair Brotli is about 1.00×. Runtime create() still uses EditorView + hostPaintEditor, not the GPU view-parts catalog.
